description: List the order requests visitors sent through the order form in the chat: number, status, products, name and phone. An order request is not paid; the team confirms it with the visitor. Needs the Standard plan or higher.

limit.description: How many requests to return (1-100, default 25).

status.description: Only requests with this status. open means new or confirmed. Leave it out for all.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

name: list_order_requests
title: List order requests
